title: Enhanced
description: A lightweight, client-side modpack focused on enhancing performance, polishing gameplay, and fixing a wide range of bugs — all while preserving the true vanilla experience. Enjoy a smoother, more stable, and refined version of Minecraft without changing it
body:
#                                        Welcome to
![Minecraft Enhanced](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/10e4bf1a5adbd4f0d8c2cf2c726ec9b889937dd6.png)

Focuses on optimization, meaningful enhancements, and subtle improvements that make Minecraft more enjoyable without altering the core gameplay.

Whether you are exploring, building, or playing with friends,
this modpack delivers a more stable and refined Minecraft experience, suitable for both solo and multiplayer gameplay.

Most of the included mods are open-source and actively maintained, ensuring fast updates, better transparency.

Key features:

- Performance and optimization improvements
- Quality of life enhancements
- Vanilla and Bedrock friendly experience
- Designed for long play on multiplayer servers
- Carefully selected open-source mods with frequent updates

<details>
<summary>Versioning</summary>


The versioning system of this modpack follows the **Y.Z format**:

### Y (Major update)
Represents major changes to the modpack:
- Minecraft version updates (26.1 → 26.2)
- Major mod updates (Sodium 7.0 → 8.0)
- Big modpack updates (Enhanced Friends update)

### Z (Minor update)
Represents small updates:
- Minecraft version updates (26.1.1 → 26.1.2)
- Mod updates
- Hotfixes and minor bug fixes

</details>
